user.title: PVOutput Publisher Configuration
user.description: Enter your global PVOutput API Key.

add_system.title: Configure Solar System
add_system.description:
Select the sensors for this solar array.

**Smart Detection:** You can select a single Power (W) OR Energy (Wh) sensor. The integration will format it, and PVOutput will estimate the missing metric.

**Maximum Accuracy:** For the best results, select BOTH a Power and an Energy sensor. The integration will automatically detect which is which and upload them simultaneously.

data_description.name: A friendly name for your own reference.
data_description.entity_id: Your inverter's power (W) or energy (Wh) sensor.
data_description.secondary_entity_id: If you selected a Power (W) sensor above, select your Energy (Wh) sensor here (or vice versa) for maximum accuracy. If left blank, PVOutput will automatically estimate the missing value.
